facts.fact: The FY2026/27 Public Investment Plan lists NUSAF IV (1 July 2025 to 30 June 2030) as establishing a National Social Registry, with the Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development to ensure interoperability and data sharing with UBOS, NIRA, NITA-U, NPA and the Ministry of Local Government; FY2026/27 funding is UShs 44.798 billion, all donor-funded.

systems.owner: Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development

note: as_of is the document's published year (2026), as the plan gives no event date for the interoperability duty.
